items.statement: Day surgery patients who received fewer antiemetic agents than the protocol recommends for their risk score have higher odds of needing rescue treatment for nausea or vomiting than patients whose prophylaxis matched (odds ratio 1.5 or more).
items.rationale: Consistent with the retrieved case-control estimate (c2); answerable within 60 hours of record reading.
items.risks: Residual confounding by operation and opioid dose.

items.statement: Patients who received more agents than recommended have higher odds of sedation delaying discharge.
items.rationale: Suggested by c4; measured from the same records.
